full-default-aarch64-musl.comment: PLAN §4.1 row 1: full default features (module-hosts,module-resolver,module-chrony,module-mounts,module-nfs,module-samba,module-dhcp,module-network,web,acme-dns01,update,init-systemd,crypto-aws-lc), aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, release, stripped. Budget <= 12 MiB (12582912 bytes). Measured via `cargo zigbuild --release -p detent --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl` on 2026-09-10. Re-cut on 2026-09-10 after two size reclaims: `/api/v1/openapi.json` now serves an `include_str!` of the checked-in document instead of building it at run time with utoipa, and utoipa plus the three crates' `openapi` features moved to [dev-dependencies], so the schema builders are never compiled into a release build rather than compiled and stripped. utoipa is no longer in the release dependency graph. Previous baseline 5101488, now 4964016 (-137472). Re-cut on 2026-09-25 (STAGE3 H20, owner-approved): the oldest commit in this repository (e4713de) already built over the 3% tolerance, so the growth predates STAGE3 and cannot be traced in the squashed history; STAGE3 itself added about 47 KB to the full build. Previous baseline 4971696, now 5272560 (+300864).

cli-aarch64-musl.comment: PLAN §4.1 row 3: CLI only, no web/acme/update. --no-default-features --features module-hosts,module-resolver,module-chrony,module-mounts,module-nfs,module-samba,module-dhcp,module-network,init-systemd, aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, release, stripped. Budget <= 3 MiB (3145728 bytes). Measured via `cargo zigbuild --release -p detent --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl --no-default-features --features module-hosts,module-resolver,module-chrony,module-mounts,module-nfs,module-samba,module-dhcp,module-network,init-systemd` on 2026-09-10. This row first had to name crypto-ring as well, because main.rs demanded a rustls provider even with `web` off; that compile_error is now gated on `web`, and the binary is byte-identical either way (1704952), which is what showed the feature was a no-op here. Re-cut on 2026-09-10 after two size reclaims: `/api/v1/openapi.json` now serves an `include_str!` of the checked-in document instead of building it at run time with utoipa, and utoipa plus the three crates' `openapi` features moved to [dev-dependencies], so the schema builders are never compiled into a release build rather than compiled and stripped. utoipa is no longer in the release dependency graph. Previous baseline 1704952, now 1705336 (+384). Re-cut on 2026-09-25 (STAGE3 H20): C1-c had pulled the Sigstore verifier and aws-lc-rs into this build (3064368 bytes); detent-platform's `update` feature now keeps them out (C1-c follow-up). The remaining growth predates STAGE3: e4713de, the oldest commit here, built to 3015088. Previous baseline 1712952, now 2104824 (+391872). Re-cut on 2026-09-26 (owner-approved): the STAGE3 hardening commits after 281b91a grew this build by about 4.4 % in small steps (measured on x86_64 at the same features: +62 KB to c50200e, +38 KB to 73e7c88 (H6), +85 KB to d050d2c; no single cause), and the check did not run while earlier CI jobs failed. Phase 6 adds 0 bytes: this build does not link detent-acme. Measured by CI (size job) at da7e772. Previous baseline 2104824, now 2198392 (+93568).

full-ui-aarch64-musl.comment: Default features plus `ui`, so the built SPA in web/dist is embedded by rust-embed. aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, release, stripped. Requires `cd web && bun run build` first; an empty web/dist compiles but embeds nothing, which would make this row meaningless. Budget <= 12 MiB. Measured 2026-09-16. The SPA costs 688,000 bytes over the same build without `ui`; web/scripts/build-finish.ts keeps only the font subsets the shipped locale needs, because unicode-range decides what a browser downloads, not what the binary carries. Re-cut on 2026-09-25 (STAGE3 H20, owner-approved): the oldest commit in this repository (e4713de) already built over the 3% tolerance, so the growth predates STAGE3 and cannot be traced in the squashed history; STAGE3 itself added about 47 KB to the full build. The SPA now costs about 820,000 bytes. Previous baseline 5659696, now 6092784 (+433088).
